data/ I/O layer

Three thin I/O modules. No business logic, no React, no adapter imports. Each wraps one type of external resource: major/minor requirement JSON files (via Vite lazy imports) and browser localStorage. Course loading belongs entirely to the ICourseCatalog adapter — there is no courseLoader module here.

Parent
src/
Called by
PlannerContext.jsx exclusively
Invariant
Zero imports from src/adapters/ or React. Path-parsing helpers come from the IMajorRequirements port passed as a parameter.

localStorage read/write for the main plan state blob. Four functions: storageKey, loadSaved, saveState, clearState. All take storagePrefix as first parameter.

majorLoader.js

Major requirement JSONs come from our own scraper output (scripts/scrape-majors.js → data/northeastern/programs/undergraduate/):

// Vite requires static string literals at the call site
const _moduleMap = import.meta.glob(
  '../../data/northeastern/programs/undergraduate/**/requirements.json',
  { eager: false }
);

All path stubs are registered at build time by Vite, but the actual JSON is never loaded until a specific major is selected. loadMajor(path) calls the stub function lazily — only one JSON is ever in memory at a time.

FunctionPurpose
getMajorOptions(majorRequirements)Return all available majors as { path, year, college, collegeLabel, folder, label, location }[]. No JSON loaded — parses paths only. Sorted newest year first, then by college, then by label. Cached by majorRequirements identity.
getMajorOptionGroups(majorRequirements)Group getMajorOptions() output by "YYYY — College Label" for <optgroup> rendering in GradPanel. Returns an ordered Map<groupKey, options[]>.
loadMajor(path)Async — lazily loads and returns the Major2 JSON for a given path. Calls canonicalizeMajorPath() first to handle stale paths from saved plans.
canonicalizeMajorPath(path)Migrates stale saved paths (older catalog years, renamed slugs, legacy submodule prefixes) to the best current registry entry via resolveInMap() in programPaths.js.

History: requirement data originally came from an external/graduatenu git submodule (1,400+ major files scraped by the GraduateNU team). Our own scraper fully replaced it and the submodule was removed; saved plans holding old submodule paths are migrated by canonicalizeMajorPath().

minorLoader.js

Identical architecture to majorLoader — scraped minors live alongside majors in data/northeastern/programs/undergraduate/, in folders ending with _minor. Exports getMinorOptions(), getMinorOptionGroups(), loadMinor(), canonicalizeMinorPath().

persistence.js

All plan state lives in one localStorage key, namespaced by institution.storagePrefix. The key format is {prefix}-state-v2 — the -v2 suffix is a schema version that allows breaking state changes to be handled cleanly (old keys are simply ignored).

FunctionPurpose
storageKey(prefix)Returns `${prefix}-state-v2`. Exported so Header can clear the key directly without importing the full module.
loadSaved(prefix)Reads and JSON-parses the saved state. Returns null if no saved state exists or if JSON is malformed.
saveState(prefix, persist, obj)Writes the plan state. When persist=false, writes {persist:false} only — a marker that tells the next load not to restore any plan state. Silently swallows quota-exceeded errors.
clearState(prefix)Removes the key from localStorage entirely (full reset).

Multiple institution forks can run in the same browser without collision because each uses a different storagePrefix (NU uses "ncp"). The generic default uses "map".

Full startup data flow

sequenceDiagram participant PC as PlannerContext participant PS as persistence.js participant CC as courseCatalog adapter participant ML as majorLoader.js participant LS as localStorage participant FS as public/northeastern/ (static) participant SCR as data/northeastern/programs/undergraduate/ (Vite stubs) PC->>PS: loadSaved(storagePrefix) PS->>LS: read {prefix}-state-v2 LS-->>PS: saved JSON or null PS-->>PC: hydrated state (or defaults) PC->>CC: courseCatalog.fetchAll() CC->>FS: fetch catalog-courses.json + term-history.json FS-->>CC: course catalog + Banner term history CC-->>PC: Course[] (normalized, termHistory merged) Note over PC: User selects major in GradPanel PC->>ML: loadMajor(path) ML->>SCR: lazy-import requirements.json ML-->>PC: Major2 requirement tree Note over PC: Any state mutation PC->>PS: saveState(prefix, persist, planObj) PS->>LS: write {prefix}-state-v2
Course loading is fully owned by the adapter — persistence.js and majorLoader.js never touch course data. Major JSONs are loaded on first selection and are not cached across sessions.

What belongs here vs. in the adapter

ConcernLives inWhy
Course fetch URL, fetch strategy, normalizationICourseCatalog adapterInstitution-specific — NU fetches static JSON + Banner history; another school might use a live API with a different schema
Major/minor JSON loadingmajorLoader.js / minorLoader.jsInstitution-agnostic path traversal — the adapter only provides path-parsing helpers (fmtLabel, fmtLocation) as parameters
localStorage read/writepersistence.jsInstitution-agnostic — the prefix parameter handles all namespacing
Locale filesLanguageContext (eager Vite glob)Loaded at context init, not on demand — different lifecycle from major data
